title: CSRF protection disabled (python) — review required
description: CSRF protection is switched off in python: csrf_exempt. State-changing endpoints then accept requests forged by attacker sites riding the victim's session. This lexical rule flags the switch; the reviewer confirms the endpoint is safe or re-enables protection.
remediation: Re-enable CSRF checks (@csrf_protect); exempt only safe, unauthenticated, or token-authenticated endpoints with a recorded reason.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the switch regardless of endpoint sensitivity.
